evidence.why: First packed map and visibility consumer.
Second map, replacement-text arguments and separate scale assignment.

facts.rationale: Corrects the stale address-named scalar account and separates constructor geometry arguments from the font-scale assignment while preserving supported map and presentation flows.
facts.value: At source level, mn_804DBE40 supplies the packed index map used for time-limit numeral hide/show operations, and mn_804DBE48 supplies the same map for attaching numeral models during construction. Initial and replacement descriptions pass -9.5f, 8.0f, 17.0f, 364.68332f and 76.77544f to HSD_SisLib_803A5ACC; a separate 0.0521f assignment sets both font-size axes. Current source uses literals for these text parameters rather than declaring mn_804DBE4C through mn_804DBE60. Their compiled addresses and section placement are not established here.

evidence.why: Incomplete state switch and conditional row/model construction.
Symbolic entry states and initial focus.

facts.rationale: Preserves supported visibility and presentation behavior while correcting the blanket claim that nonzero constructor states select valid transition settings.
facts.value: Initial presentation depends on the supplied state and shared hovered selection. State 0 skips the initial transition request. Within the nonzero-state branch, numeric states 1 and 3 select mn_803ED294[3] and mn_803ED294[4]; state 2 breaks without assigning als, and other nonzero states likewise have no assignment before als->start_frame is used. This is not a general safe nonzero-state constructor contract. Option construction omits row 1 in Tournament mode and conditionally omits rows 3 and 5. Visible rows receive selection-dependent cursor frames and visibility flags; row 5 has specialized cursor treatment and no ordinary value model, while rows 0–4 initialize value models from cached rules. The entry initializer chooses MENU_STATE_EXIT_TO with row 5 when returning from Rules Stage and MENU_STATE_ENTER_TO with row 0 otherwise.
